text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The morning of her debut, Yaeno Muteki practices some Kongo Yaegaki katas to calm the flames inside her until the proper time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems to pay off, as her fighting spirit is ignited just before the race begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki's debut race is finally about to start!
